what: Pressing a pad (tab) makes the header lines of the neighboring screen exit upward by −105% in half-beat steps at sixteenth-note (.106s) intervals while the rest blur, then the new content rises from 105% below in one beat and the rest float up from 8px below at eighth-note (.211s) intervals. The pad bounces back from .95x as if pressed

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
